events.content:
Done. `BlogHeader.tsx` now loads both fonts via `next/font/google`, with everything contained in the component file: - `Playfair Display` is applied to the `

` heading via `playfairDisplay.className`. - `Roboto` (weight 400, since `next/font` requires an explicit weight for it) is applied to the `

` subtitle via `roboto.className`. Using `next/font` means the fonts are downloaded at build time and self-hosted — no runtime requests to Google, no layout shift, and no `` tags needed in the layout. The build passes with the change. One note: because the font loaders live in `BlogHeader.tsx`, the fonts only apply where that component uses them. If you later want them available site-wide, the conventional spot is `app/layout.tsx`, but per your request the logic stays in the header component.
